what: A rhythm game for the FM-1. Load songs from the browser Studio, turn any MIDI file into a song: your part's notes fall to the keys and you play KEYS, DRUMS, GUITAR or BASS while the FM-1 plays the rest on its synth engines. Every note judged, with combos and best scores.
author: Shan-Sherif
sounds: CC0: piano and flute samples from Versilian Studios (VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL); the drums and every other sound are synthesised in code
